name: Elinzanetant
summary: Elinzanetant, sold under the brand name Lynkuet, is a medication used for the treatment of moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms (hot flashes) due to menopause. It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: The drug acts as a selective neurokinin NK1 and NK3 receptor antagonist.
pharmacology.kind: Neurokinin NK1 and NK3 receptor antagonist

uses.text: Elinzanetant is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms associated with menopause.
